label: C04
patientMessage: I recommend an in-person foot assessment today (urgent care, your diabetes/foot clinic, or an emergency department if nothing else is available) rather than messaging alone. In diabetes, redness, swelling and tenderness around a wound on the sole can mean infection, and someone needs to look at the wound, judge how deep it is and check the circulation in your foot. I can help coordinate in this thread. Go to an emergency department now if you develop fever or chills, rapidly expanding redness, severe pain, dusky or blackening skin, or foul drainage.
reason: Diabetic patient with a 4-day-old plantar wound now with surrounding redness, mild swelling and tenderness on pressure — features of a possible diabetic foot infection. Hands-on assessment today is needed to inspect the wound, judge depth and circulation and decide on treatment; messaging alone cannot examine the foot.
